column1: # MIDROW_RUNS_release_N.tsv: the records of the certified middle-row runs and the runs that wrote them, one row per shipped record.
# Columns: record (release path); original_sha256 (the archived record); release_sha256 (the shipped bytes); producer (release path of the
# program that wrote the record); folder (the folder the run starts in); command (the program call as the run made it, without its
# output redirections: the run's standard output is the .out record it lists; or the RUNS_M2_release_N.tsv row that repeats the run);
#   rerun: the RUNS_M2_release_N.tsv row named writes the shipped bytes; the package driver rerun_m2.py repeats it;
#   copy: the same bytes as the record named, staged into a certificate set by the run named;
#   carried: the shipped bytes are the archived record with the T, G and P changes of CORRESPONDENCE_release_N.tsv; a rerun of the
#   program on the package stops where the status says (or, where it says so, writes the same record rows).
# Every other file of the package: CORRESPONDENCE_release_N.tsv.
